money.setAsideHint: The most you can move now without dipping under your buffer in the next {days} days.
money.shortfallHint: Short by this much for what is already scheduled in the next {days} days.
money.currentSummary: {in} in, {out} out so far this week.
money.noTransactions: No transactions yet — add them in Expensave and they show up here.
money.settings.hint: Tick the Expensave calendars to follow and give each one a colour; they become a layer you can switch on and off on the calendar.
money.settings.none: No Expensave calendars — check EXPENSAVE_URL, EXPENSAVE_EMAIL and EXPENSAVE_PASSWORD.
bank.title: Bank statement
bank.never: Not synced with the bank yet. Every {days} days, download the last {days} days of transactions as CSV and upload it here.
bank.result: Expensave updated: {matched} planned entries confirmed, {added} added, {removed} removed.
bank.balanceHint: Saved as an Expensave balance update, so “safe to set aside” starts from the real balance.
bank.balanceMissing: Leave it empty to keep Expensave's own running balance. Adding it keeps the set-aside number accurate.
bank.gap_one: {days} day between the last statement ({date}) and this one is not covered. Its transactions will be missing, but the balance above still corrects the total.
bank.gap_other: {days} days between the last statement ({date}) and this one are not covered. Their transactions will be missing, but the balance above still corrects the total.
bank.missing_one: {count} planned entry the bank never saw
bank.missing_other: {count} planned entries the bank never saw
bank.missingHint: Remove what did not happen or was replaced by real purchases (e.g. a grocery budget). Keep “still coming” for what just hasn't cleared yet — it stays reserved.
bank.matched_one: {count} planned entry confirmed by the bank
bank.matched_other: {count} planned entries confirmed by the bank
bank.duplicates_one: {count} transaction was already imported and is skipped.
bank.duplicates_other: {count} transactions were already imported and are skipped.
money.plugin.title: Money (Expensave)
money.plugin.description: Transactions on the calendar and what is safe to set aside each week, from Expensave.
money.plugin.setup: Set EXPENSAVE_URL, EXPENSAVE_EMAIL and EXPENSAVE_PASSWORD on the server.
money.statementToday: Based on your bank statement through {date}.
money.statementAge_one: Based on your bank statement through {date}, {count} day ago.
money.statementAge_other: Based on your bank statement through {date}, {count} days ago.
money.statementLate_one: Your last bank statement ends {date}, {count} day ago: upload a new one before trusting this.
money.statementLate_other: Your last bank statement ends {date}, {count} days ago: upload a new one before trusting this.
money.noStatement: No bank statement yet, so everyday spending isn't counted: upload one below before trusting this.
money.everydayUnknown: Everyday spending needs two weeks of statements before it is counted.
money.movedHint: Added to Expensave as a transfer today, so this amount drops now. The next bank statement confirms it.
money.settings.everydayHint: Leave empty to estimate it from your bank statements (median of the last 6 weeks).
bank.addsUp: Adds up to the cent with your bank since the {date} balance.
bank.short: Since the {date} balance, Expensave would be {amount} below your bank: a deposit is probably missing from this file. Check it before applying — the balance you typed is applied either way.
bank.over: Since the {date} balance, Expensave would be {amount} above your bank: a charge is probably missing from this file, or something is counted twice.
bank.twins_one: {count} row an earlier upload wrote twice will be removed
bank.twins_other: {count} rows earlier uploads wrote twice will be removed
bank.recurring_one: {count} repeating charge isn't in your plan
bank.recurring_other: {count} repeating charges aren't in your plan
bank.recurringHint: Add them to Expensave as recurring entries so they're reserved on their day. Until then they count as everyday spending.
bank.refreshed_one: {count} transaction imported while still pending gets its final description.
bank.refreshed_other: {count} transactions imported while still pending get their final description.
bank.verified: Checked: every bank row is in Expensave.
bank.lastForecast: Last statement: HomeBoard expected {forecast}, the bank had {balance} ({off}).
